server: LabServer63 (main); evidence root ~/rest_sym79; read-only inputs ~/rest_repr68, ~/rest_cover71, ~/rest_cmp72, ~/rest_src73, ~/rest_ato74, ~/rest_rank75, ~/rest_rank75L, ~/rest_srcid78, ~/rest_arch77a (WL77A Part 0: scored in WL78, development data only here)
question: Is insufficient angular-frame equivariance a material cause of the remaining Q78 boundary-transfer failure, and can symmetry-consistent supervision address it within the existing rank-16 ATO / W+UV-Q representation?

controls.note: historical final checkpoints, unchanged; never retrained

stage0.group: rest slab: D4h = D4 x {id, z-flip} (sym72.ops(True), 16 operations); dented pose with centre c: D4 maps it to the pose with centre op(c) (z-flip excluded); self-symmetries: op(c) = c
stage0.convention: sym79 module docstring: perm[p] = port at op(x0_p); Q[p] = F_dst[perm p] M F_src[p]^T; pin / pout = bin maps of the bin-centre directions (N = 4 / 8); S'[pin[p,a], perm[j], pout[j,o], c] = S[a, j, o, c], i.e. K(gG) = P_out(g) K(G) P_in(g)^-1; d'[pin[p,a]] = d[a]
stage0.exactness: a map is exact when every mapped bin centre coincides with a bin centre (residual <= 1e-9) and every per-port map is a bijection; exact labels are built only from exact maps
stage0.geometry_checks: port bijection; frame map structure (normal preserved, tangent block a D4 element); bin-map residual / bijectivity; fine16 and coarse-cell commutation; refined-mesh identity of op(G) and the image geometry; beta equivariance (quadrature noise); W+UV-Q input equivariance (probe-tie ports counted)
stage0.reference_controls: stage0_79.py refs docstring (positive: exact pairs, first 2 per operation, and self-fixed sources; negative: identity bin maps, t<->b swapped bin maps, class-2 translation pairs with different boundary context; reading rules predeclared there)
stage0.pre_freeze_development_run: the geometry check and a partial reference run (the first 8 positive pairs: differences 0.95-1.03 x replica noise; every negative control detected) were run on the dev root before this freeze; the dented-pose maps were found NOT exact there (first-triangle frames of a non-D4-symmetric refined triangulation: normal tilt up to 0.08, bin residual 0.06-0.16, some outgoing maps not bijective). Consequence frozen here: exact transformed labels exist for the rest geometry only.

stage1.sources: S16-R rest training sources (16; fit73.populations S16R), fit targets = means of fitting replicas 0-3 (fit_targets73.pt sha256 20f631ed...), scoring = held-out replicas 4-7 of the same bundles
stage1.ops_rationale: chosen from the Stage 0 frame-map table before any oracle outcome: in-plane 90 and 180 degree rotations, an axis reflection and a diagonal reflection (top/bottom tangent maps R90 / R180 / reflections), the top <-> bottom exchange (id+z) and a top <-> bottom exchange combined with a rotation (r90+z); every side face is mapped to another side face or to itself with a non-identity tangent map by at least one of them

oracle.convergence_check: the same budget again from the solution (relative J change reported)
oracle.basis: frozen G2 (rank75_v1.json basis: selected restart, sha256 asserted), A = softmax over r, O = softmax over o
oracle.budget: d' = transformed 1 - beta of the original source (exact isolation of the angular permutation)

groups.rule: BND = sources whose nearest port with a perpendicular normal is within 10 mm (geometry only); INT = the rest; ALL = 16

gate.rule: for every predeclared operation and group: transformed pooled worst-channel upper-95 % bound (eval68 hi) <= 1.25 x the original oracle's, for every metric; and no WL59 gate (wl59) passed by the original oracle is failed by the transformed oracle
gate.requires: Stage 0 contract VALID (geometry: all rest maps exact and commuting; references: stage0 refs summary.valid)
gate.fail: ANGULAR BASIS LIMIT: stop; no A/O change, no rank change; the required architectural change is reported as an unresolved human decision

stage1.closure: descriptive algebraic analysis of A, O and the joint rank-1 patterns under the 8 D4 tangent maps (rank assignment, relative Frobenius error)

stage2.frozen_before: any candidate fit and any Stage 1 oracle outcome (committed together with Stages 3-6 while the Stage 1 oracle runs; the chain trains only if the Stage 1 gate passes)
stage2.intervention: symmetry-consistent presentation (fit79.SymRest): at optimizer step t, rest S16-R source k is presented under the exact rest operation OPS[(k + t) mod 16] (OPS = sym72.ops(True), identity first): image port perm[p_k] in the rest geometry, label = exact image of its fitting-replica-0-3 mean (receiver ports, incoming and outgoing bins; sym79), model budget = 1 - beta of the rest geometry at the image port; deterministic Latin schedule: every step contains all 16 operations once, every source sees each operation once per 16 steps
stage2.pt0: identity presentation only: dented-pose maps are not exact (Stage 0), so no exact transformed angular label exists
stage2.unchanged: operator q78.TransportQ (rank 16, frozen G2 A/O, WL78 inputs, layers, capacity); objective J = mean(rest term, pt0 term) of ato74.objective_m + 1.0 L_sym (WL72 term, identical labels and code); 16 rest + 16 pt0 physical samples per update; optimizer, schedule, steps, clip, checkpoints, final iterate; no new label, loss term, hyperparameter or MC supervision
stage2.confound: the effective training distribution changes: the 16 rest sources are presented at the 192 ports of their exact orbit (16 operations), each orientation 1/16 of the time (the original orientation 1/16 instead of always); this is exact physical information obtained without new MC labels, not a new physical source-reference budget; S16-R already contained orbit-related pairs (e.g. 944 <-> 2707 under r90)
stage2.records: initial / final J use the identity presentation (the Q78-comparable objective); the per-step history J is the presented (transformed) objective
stage2.initialisation: the Q78 rule (q78.init_model: P_590x trunk, rank rows r mod 8, frozen G2 A/O, encoder / pair_layer re-initialised with seed 7801 / 7802): the S79 initial state equals the Q78 initial state bitwise (test T4)

optimizer.objective: J (ato74.objective_m; rest term under the symmetry presentation) + 1.0 * L_sym (WL72)
optimizer.training_data: S16-R fit_targets73.pt (fitting replicas 0-3), rest and pt0; WL72 pt0 symmetry-image geometries (L_sym only)

execution.chain: chain79.py after runA: [Stage 1 gate passed] tests -> full-scale probe (non-evidence; lanes) -> two fits -> Stage 3 + fit gate -> [passed] Stage 4 mechanism -> [improved] Stage 5 population freeze check + references + Stage 5 -> Stage 6 deformation (descriptive when an earlier gate stopped) + cost -> export; one detached setsid process; any failure stops; dev smoke first (40-step fits, 2-slot references, forced gates, no metric used)
execution.lanes_rule: probe both runs concurrently with the real configuration; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane
execution.precision: float32 model and training (TF32 off), float64 oracle / estimators
execution.hardware: LabServer63 RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB (Q78 trained there too, 2 lanes)

gate.rule: each S79 seed: hi <= 1.25 x max over the Q78 seeds for every group / metric; validity: every passivity check passed and A/O bitwise the frozen basis; both seeds must pass
gate.outcomes: FIT GATE PASSED -> Stage 4; INSUFFICIENT FIT -> stop (diagnose; no tuning); PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE -> stop

stage3.q78_reproduction: Q78 group values recomputed here vs the recorded WL78 Stage 3 (same code / data / checkpoints): reported
stage3.transformed_training: exact images (Stage 1 operations) of the S16-R held-out replicas 4-7: Q78 / A75 / S79 pooled per operation (descriptive; held-out replicas, never used for selection)

gate.rule: M1: for each S79 seed vs the same-seed Q78: mean over the three historical pairs (101<-50, 105<-52, 107<-53; exact op + in-face translation, exact port / bin maps; WL78 mech78 definition) of the worst-channel near-field (0-5 mm) relative difference between the far-source prediction and the mapped training-source prediction <= 0.5 x the Q78 value, native AND fine16 contrast, both seeds
gate.fail: stop before Stage 5 (no independent references are generated): the symmetry discrepancy is not reduced

stage4.descriptive: M2 learned equivariance (prediction at the image port vs exact image of the prediction; 15 operations; training and out-of-orbit development sources; native / fine16 contrast; near field and total), M3 WL77A Part 0 groups and DEF (development; scored in WL78), strata 5-10 / 10-20 / > 20 mm, error of far and mapped sources, physical difference
stage4.orbit_check: the far ports of the historical pairs (224, 260, 1568) and the WL74 S4 / WL77A Part 0 ports are not in the S16-R orbit (geometry check before the freeze)

stage5.population: ports79.py (geometry only; ports76 rules; excludes 107 earlier referenced / scored ports and all their images, and the 192-port training orbit); proposed before any candidate exists
stage5.empty_slots: TBC 5-7 and SV far 18-19: no admissible port under the exclusion / spacing rules (recorded, not replaced)
stage5.references: probes79.py: probes74 code unchanged (WL57 fast walker, gates, 32M / 16M, K = 4), rest geometry, seeds 79000000 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep; generated only after the Stage 3 and Stage 4 gates pass; qualification by eval73 precision rules

decision.stronger: per group, the control pair (Q78 or A75) with the lower mean over its two seeds of con_coarse hi (AR reported)
decision.far_rule: far = YES iff max over S79 seeds of BND_FAR con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over the stronger control seeds AND < min of their lower 95 % bounds; NO iff min S79 > 0.8 x max stronger; else OVERLAP; near likewise
decision.regression_rule: YES iff min S79 >= 1.25 x max of the better control (Q78 or A75 by mean) for that group / metric; NO iff max S79 < 1.25 x min; else OVERLAP
decision.verdict: far YES and no regression YES -> SYMMETRY TRAINING BENEFIT; far YES with a regression YES -> INCONCLUSIVE (benefit with material regression); far NO -> EQUIVARIANCE IMPROVED, TRANSFER UNCHANGED (the mechanism gate passed to reach Stage 5); far OVERLAP -> INCONCLUSIVE; validity failure -> PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE. Stage 1 fail -> ANGULAR BASIS LIMIT; fit gate fail -> INSUFFICIENT FIT; mechanism gate fail -> no transfer claim (Stage 5 not run; symmetry discrepancy not reduced: negative answer to the completion question for this intervention). WL59 gates reported separately; per-matrix and per-channel values reported

stage6.deformation: existing qualified deformation references (development, already scored): DEF71 (cf2 - rest), CONFDEF72 (te2 - rest), DEF73 (te0 - rest) from Stage 3 and WL77A Part 0 DEF (te1 - rest) from Stage 4 M3; S79 vs Q78 vs A75: worst-channel relative error (abs_coarse hi), correlation, slope; WL59 deformation gate (error <= 0.35, corr >= 0.90)
stage6.flag_rule: per group: WORSE iff every S79 seed has worst-channel error >= 1.25 x max Q78 or min-channel corr <= min Q78 - 0.03; RECOVERED iff every S79 seed has error <= max Q78 / 1.25 and corr >= max Q78; else MAINTAINED/OVERLAP. DEFORMATION REGRESSION iff the primary group (the WL78 regression population) is WORSE
stage6.runs_even_if_stopped: Stage 6 deformation and cost are always measured (descriptive when an earlier gate stopped; never change an earlier verdict)
stage6.cost: cost79.py: Q78_5901 vs S79_5901 (A75 reference): parameters, state, rebuild, coefficients, 1 / 64-light apply, peak GPU, training time, augmentation cost; significant deviation iff any runtime ratio deviates from 1 by more than 25 %
